name: Dirtmouth
description: Dirtmouth, the Fading Town, is the first town on the way to Hallownest.

npc.name: Old Sage
npc.dialogue: Courage is not found, it is recognized. Take this medallion and remember the word DREAM.

name: Forgotten Crossroads
description: Located right below the surface, the Forgotten Crossroads consists of many caverns and roads.

npc.name: Forgotten Merchant
npc.dialogue: What word did the Old Sage teach you?

enemy.name: False Knight
enemy.dialogue: A giant armored bug blocks your path holding a massive mace!

name: Greenpath
description: Greenpath is a lush cavern filled with vegetation, mossy valleys, and acidic lakes.

npc.name: Flora Guardian
npc.dialogue: What is the word of the ancient crossroads?

enemy.name: Moss Knight
enemy.dialogue: A moss-covered knight draws his greatsword and shields the path ahead!

name: Crystal Peak
description: Crystal Peak contains vast tunnels carved through shining crystal formations.

npc.name: Miner
npc.dialogue: What echoes through the crystal tunnels?

enemy.name: Crystal Guardian
enemy.dialogue: A crystallized bug resting on a bench wakes up screaming, shooting searing lasers!

name: Resting Grounds
description: The Resting Grounds are filled with tombstones, monuments, and lingering spirits.

enemy.name: Xero (Warrior Dream)
enemy.dialogue: A lingering spirit summons spectral swords that float around him. Prepare to dodge!

name: Howling Cliffs
description: A steep cliff at the edge of Hallownest, battered by endless winds.

npc.name: Seal Guardian
npc.dialogue: What is the final word carried by the winds?
npc.ending: The ancient seal shatters. The five relics shine together, revealing the path to the Heart of Hallownest. Your journey is complete.
